name: docs
description: Functional-document authoring: ADR, PRD, SPEC, LLD, PLAN, ROADMAP, TICKET, TASK — standards, maker, review, validator, eight type templates, and file-bug (capture -> classify -> record -> dispatch -> write-back for bug reports). Also covers research/measurement (research-methods, make-rubric), markdown↔markup conversion (markdown-to-markup, html-to-markdown), knowledge/reference authoring (make-reference, make-llms-txt, make-vision-memo — knowledge-pack authoring lives in harness's make-pack), and a fresh-context doc-checker agent alongside the experiment-runner agent.
